articles.title: Australian shark attack victim grateful for 'second chance at life'
articles.description: Leah Stewart was mauled by a shark in June, suffering multiple bites to her arms and legs.

articles.title: Dozens of co-ordinated arson attacks hit southern Thailand
articles.description: No group has claimed responsibility for the attacks, which the military said "aimed at creating unrest".

articles.title: Girl, 17, killed in Swedish sword attack, police say
articles.description: Two boys aged 12 and 17 were also injured, while an 18-year-old suspect has been detained.

articles.title: '17-year-old girl killed' in sword attack at Swedish school
articles.description: A 17-year-old girl was killed when a teenager armed with a sword attacked students at a school in Sweden, reports say.
